$comment: Work list for Calo (native) and the shared skeleton. Flip passes to true only with scripts/pass-feature.sh after scripts/verify.sh exits 0. Never edit or delete an entry; add a note in PROGRESS.md instead. Order is build order; dependsOn must pass first.

features.title: XcodeGen project.yml with the Calo app target, three packages, unit and UI test targets, privacy manifest, strings catalog
acceptance: xcodegen generate succeeds
empty app builds for the iPhone 17 simulator
Package.swift for DesignSystem (MainActor), CaloKit and CalcKit (nonisolated), language mode 6
CalcKit imports Foundation only; CaloKit Foundation, GRDB, OSLog (verify.sh step 2)
PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy with the UserDefaults reason
portrait only, iPhone only
Localizable.xcstrings present

features.title: verify.sh gate, pass-feature.sh, protect-paths hook, .claude settings
acceptance: verify.sh runs protected-file check, boundaries, swiftlint --strict, swiftformat --lint, xcodegen, build-for-testing, unit tests, UI tests on one simulator with parallel testing off
exits non-zero on any failure, skip or expected failure, or a count drop against .verify/last-green.txt
pass-feature.sh flips a C- or K- id only with a matching green stamp and passing dependsOn
hook blocks edits under spec/, and under Tests/, UITests/, the gate files once they are on main
